Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City DILG OPINION No. Ph 313023 MAR 22 2023 MARY DOVIE C. ARCAYA-PO Secretary to the Sanggunian Sangguniang Bayan Gumaca, Quezon Dear Ms. Arcaya-Po: This pertains to your letter dated October 6, 2022 requesting for the Department's opinion on the subject matter of the proposed ordinance submitted by one of the members of the Sangguniang Bayan of Gumaca, Quezon. In the herein request for the Department's legal opinion, the antecedent facts are as follows: A Sangguniang Bayan Member of Gumaca, Quezon, proposed an ordinance entitled "AN ORDINANCE ENACTING THE SANGGUNIANG BAYAN RULES AND REGULATIONS IN CONCURRING MUNICIPAL DEPARTMENT HEADS OF THE MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT OF GUMACA, QUEZON". It was represented in the letter that according to the proponent of said ordinance, the Municipal Council of Gumaca will regulate the re-submission of the appointment paper of the appointed Department Heads for Sangguniang Bayan concurrence whose appointment was disapproved/unconcurred by the Sangguniang Bayan for three consecutive times. In view thereof, the query is on whether the proposed ordinance is beyond the power conferred upon the Sangguniang Bayan. We are not privy to the actual provisions of the proposed Sanggunian as there was no copy of the ordinance submitted. Thus, we shall answer the query mainly based on the representations provided in the letter-request. With the Sangguniang Bayan devising a way to regulate, by virtue of an ordinance, the re-submission of appointment papers of Department Head appointees that was already disapproved/unconcurred by the concerned sanggunian for three consecutive times, the local legislative body is merely giving finality to their actions pursuant to Section 443 (d) of R.A. No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991", which reads: "(d) Unless otherwise provided herein, heads of Departments and offices shall be appointed by the municipal mayor with the concurrence of the majority of all the Sangguniang Bayan members, subject to civil service law, rules and regulations. The Sangguniang Bayan shall act on the "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

appointment within fifteen (15) days from the date of its submission; otherwise, the same shall be deemed confirmed." Providing finality to the Sanggunian's third-time disapproval of the appointments contemplated in the aforementioned provision will avoid repetitive insistence from the Local Chief Executive to appoint the very same person whose appointment had already been rejected thrice. The same appears to be reasonable. This will save the sanggunian's time which may be used to address more pressing concerns of the local government. Thus, so long as the provisions of the assailed proposed ordinance is also not contrary to civil service law, rules and regulations, the same is not to be deemed beyond the power conferred upon the sanggunian. This opinion is provided without prejudice to contrary opinion/decision of competent authorities and the proper court. We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, BY H RITY OF THE SECRETARY: R R. LLAMAS ATTY AN V rs cretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OU E JVRULLLS-LRALLD/kbm copy furnished: DIR. ARIEL O.
